# Ellenhorn

> > Community-based psychiatric recovery program providing person-centered, evidence-based treatment across Boston, New York, and Los Angeles.

Ellenhorn is a psychiatric recovery organization specializing in intensive community-based treatment using the PACT (Program of Assertive Community Treatment) model and mobile team approaches. The organization combines clinical expertise with peer support and whole-person care philosophy, serving individuals with serious mental illness, psychosis, and dual diagnoses.

## Key Topics

- PACT (Program of Assertive Community Treatment)
- Psychiatric recovery
- Community-based treatment
- Psychosis care
- Dual-diagnosis treatment
- Mobile team approach
- Whole-person care
- Open Dialogue
- IDDT (Integrated Dual Diagnosis Treatment)
- AMBIT (Adaptive Mentalization-Based Integrative Treatment)
- Treatment without walls
- Intensive outpatient programs
- Community integration
- Peer specialist roles
- De-prescribing
